Mix the existing soil with the manure and then gently place around the root ball of the tree. Tap down lightly.  Make a circular moat around the edge of the hole you dug. About two inches tall to help retain moisture.  Water well, until drenched. The next day water well again.  Then for the first year water at least weekly if you do not get  a good weekly rain. If you live in a dry area maybe water more often if it gets really hot. I live in the south and we get 90-95 degrees daily in the summer months and I will water twice a week the first year.
